notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes (v0.0.2) – June 8
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the incubator would freeze during the second hatching.
Fixed a bug where additional stamina and card draws were consumed during the first hatching.
Fixed incorrect food consumption display in the tooltip.

Upcoming features include:

Inventory system

Tribe system

Main storyline

Future era updates

For feedback and discussion,


https://discord.com/invite/jTcQBaaxS7
